graphics_resolved.resolution_rule: transitive walk of the registry `depends` chain (graphics -> compute -> base) per core version, not a manual sum of categories

command_contracts.resolution_rule: the resolved core command surface grouped into differentiable contracts by API area; one requirement row per contract

formats.resolution_rule: each row is a format plus the feature bits the specification requires for it; an empty marker means the feature is not mandatory for that format
